notes: Version protocol: platform/VERSIONING.md. This file is the single source of truth; gradle.properties, web/package.json, web/src/shared/version.ts, the README version block and the CHANGELOG headings are GENERATED from it (scripts/ci/sync_versions.py) and must never be hand-edited. Each active component under apps/* and web/* carries an INDEPENDENT version line, bumped by CI only when that component's own `paths` changed in the promotion range (D1, 2026-08-17) — a web-only merge does not move the Android version. `excludedPaths` are generated files: they are the EFFECT of a release, never a cause, and are ignored by every component's path match. `libs.*` and `platformContractVersion` are contract versions, NOT release versions — they are deliberately frozen and bumped by hand only when a :libs:* public contract changes, gated on an ADR (D2, 2026-08-17); CI asserts they never change silently and that every `requiresCore`/`requiresSettings` constraint is satisfied. Do not hand-edit any `version` or `buildNumber` field.
